<entry id="S01603">
<head-word>קָנַס</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (sec. r. of קס, v. 
<xref rid="S01676">קסס</xref>) [
<italic>to cut</italic>,] (cmp. גזר) 
<italic>to decree; to fine, punish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 75
<sup>b</sup> top קָנַסְתִּי מיתה על וכ' I decreed death over Adam. Num. R. s. 18 אין קוֹנְסִים אלא וכ' none are punished below twenty years of age, v. עָנַשׁ. Gen. R. s. 20, beg. למה הייתם קוֹנְסִין את בני why did you fine (confiscate the property of) my children?; Yalk. Ps. 888; a. fr.—Esp. 
<italic>to decree a penalty beyond the strict law</italic>. B. Mets. 72
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. שטר … קונסין אותו וכ' if interest is stipulated in a document, we fine him (the creditor) so that he cannot collect either the principal or the interest. B. Kam. 30
<sup>b</sup> קָנְסוּ גופן משום שבחן they decreed the forfeiture of the objects themselves on account of the illegitimate gain intended. Sabb. 3
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. קָנְסוּ שוגג אטו וכ', v. אָטוּ. B. Kam. 38
<sup>b</sup> קנס הוא שקנס וכ' (not שקניס) R. M. put a penalty on their property (declared their goods eventually unclean). Ib. הכי נמי נִקְנוֹס let us also fine (the Samaritan woman, by disallowing her the fine due for seduction). Yeb. 86
<sup>b</sup> קנסו לוים במעשר they punished the Levites by depriving them of the tithes (in favor of the priests); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִקְנָס</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be decreed</italic> (as a punishment).</definition>
<notes> Erub. 18
<sup>b</sup> כיון שראה שנִקְנְסָה מיתה וכ' when he (Adam) perceived that through his fault death was decreed (over the human race), he fasted &c.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sup>b</sup> מי קַנְסוּהָ רבנן לאהדורי וכ' do the Rabbis punish him by forbidding him to withdraw his hand? Ib. בשוגג לא קנסוה וכ' if he did it by mistake, the Rabbis do not punish him. Ib. ליקנסוה רבנן let the Rabbis punish him (by forbidding him to withdraw his hand)!; a. fr.—B. Mets. 72
<sup>a</sup> קנסינן התירא וכ' we decree the forfeiture of the legitimate claim (the principal) on account of the illegitimate (the interest; a. e.).</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>

<definition>
<italic>to be punished, fined, condemned</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 25. Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 50.</notes></sense>
<sense>

<definition>
<italic>to be assessed for fine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 22 מתקנסא יתקנס וולדא the lost embryo must be paid for according to assessment (h. text ענוש יענש).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01605">
<head-word>קְנָס</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>fine, penalty</italic>, esp. 
<italic>the fine for seducing a girl</italic> (Deut. XXII, 29).</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 38
<sup>b</sup>, v. קָנס. Keth. 43
<sup>a</sup> top, a. e. מודה בק' פטור he who confesses an act with which 
<pgbrk id="pg1394" />a fine is connected, is exempt from the fine; ib. 42
<sup>a</sup>; Shebu. V, 4 אינו משלם ק' על פי עצמו none needs to pay a fine on his own confession (if he cannot be convicted otherwise). Keth. l. c. (in Chald. dict.) ק' הוי it is the case of a fine, opp. ממונא the case of a real debt or indemnity. Ib. bot. יצאו אלו שהן ק' exclude those cases which concern only a fine, opp. ממון. Ib. III, 1 יש להן ק' a fine is due for seducing them. Ib. 29
<sup>a</sup> יש לה מכר ואין לה ק' she can be sold (by her father), and no fine is due for her seduction. Ib. III, 8 כל … מכר אין ק' wherever sale can take place, there is no fine for seduction. Ib. 3 קְנָסָהּ לעצמה the fine for her seduction belongs to herself (and not to her father); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קְנָסוֹת</plural-form>. Snh. 8
<sup>a</sup> דיני ק' בכמה how many judges are required for the adjudication of a fine? Keth. 43
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—[קנסות, Zeb. 88
<sup>b</sup> ed., v. קוֹלָס.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01606">

<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 30 (h. text כפר). Targ. Y. Num. XV, 32 ק' דשבתא the penalty for violating the Sabbath laws.—Snh. 3
<sup>a</sup>; B. Kam. 15
<sup>a</sup>, v. מָמוֹנָא. Keth. 29
<sup>b</sup> בני ק' persons for whose seduction a fine is due. Pes. 29
<sup>a</sup>; 30
<sup>a</sup> ר"ש ק' קניס וכ' R. S. (in declaring leavened matter kept over Passover forbidden even after Passover) imposes a penalty, because the person has transgressed the law &c. Yeb. 86
<sup>a</sup> ק' לעניים the penalty (the forfeit of the tithes decreed over the Levites) was to benefit the poor; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קְנָסִין, קְנָסַיָּא</plural-form>. Targ. Y. I Ex. XV, 25.—Y. Yeb. XIV, beg. 14
<sup>b</sup> עוד היא באילין ק' she is still subject to those penalties (that she must leave both husbands).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01610">
<head-word>קַנְקָל</head-word>
<head-word>קִינְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cancellus, κίγκλις) 
<italic>any reticulated object</italic>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a perforated vessel</italic> for fumigation.</definition>
<notes> Deut. R. s. 10 (ref. to Is. LV, 3) האזן לגוף כקי' לכלים the ear is to the body what the fumigating vessel is to garments; שכן הקי' כמה כלים וכ' as many garments are put on the ḳ. and all are fumigated, so there are 248 limbs in man, and all live through the ear (by listening to the word of God); Pesik. Shim’ʿu, p. 117
<sup>a</sup> קנקל; Yalk. Jer. 264, a. Yalk. Is. 341 קנקן.—Kel. XXII, 10 קנקילין שיש בה … כסות f. (Bab. ed. קנקילן … כוסות, corr. acc.) a fumigating vessel with a receptacle for garments.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>latticed gate</italic> or 
<italic>bar</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. V, beg. 7
<sup>b</sup> קִינְקִילוֹן גורר a latticed gate which drags along on the ground when opened; Y. Erub. X, 26
<sup>b</sup> bot. קנְקִילוֹן גודר; Tosef. ib. XI (VIII), 13 קַנְקַלִּין הגוררין Var. (ed. Zuck. קנקנין); Erub. 101
<sup>a</sup> קנקן הנגרר.—Esp. 
<plural-form>pl. קַנְקַלִּים, קַנְקַלִּין, קַנְקִילִּ', קִינְ'</plural-form>
<italic>screens, bars of the court of justice, of idolatrous temples</italic>, &c. Gen. R. s. 78 (ref. to Gen. XXXIII, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> הוי … משבעה קי' וכ' consider thyself as if placed behind seven bars and sitting as judge &c. Y’land. to Lev. XIX quot. in Ar. המולך … קנקלים וכ' how was the Moloch worship arranged? There was an idol behind seven enclosures &c. Y. Orl. I, end, 61
<sup>c</sup> הכניסה לפנים מן הקנקי' when he brought it (the egg) behind the enclosures of the idolatrous temple; Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43
<sup>a</sup> הקנקל'. Ib. 42
<sup>d</sup> bot. כל שהכניסו … הק' אסרו whatever one brings within the enclosures one makes forbidden (as an object dedicated to idolatry). Ib. II, 41
<sup>b</sup> ע"ז שאין לה ק' … ידון לשם ק' if an idolatrous temple has no bars, the whole building is considered as bars (whatever is brought within the premises, is forbidden). Cant. R. to III, 4, v. צְנִיעוּת. Lev. R. s. 19, end דרך ק' שלשלוה לו they let her down to him over the bars; a. e.—Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>d</sup> top, v. קֶלַע III.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01614">
<head-word>קַנְקָן</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָנַן) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a cylindrical vessel let into the ground of the cellar</italic> (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Dolium), in gen. 
<italic>wine-</italic> or 
<italic>oil-vessel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 20 אל תסתכל בק' וכ' look not at the vessel but at what it contains; יש ק' חדש וכ' many a new vessel is full of old wine (many a young man is a fine scholar) &c. Koh. R. to VII, 28 ק' … מקַנְקַנּוֹ וכ', v. infra. Gen. R. s. 85 נטלו ק' אחד וכ' they took one cask in the cellar &c.; החזירו את הק' למקומה (read: למקומו) put the cask back into its place. Y. Succ. I, 52
<sup>b</sup> bot. כמשלח … וקַנְקַנָּהּ like one sending to his neighbor a cask of wine and the storage vessel with it (making a present of both); Gen. R. s. 13; Yalk. Ps. 882. Y. Bets. IV, beg. 62
<sup>b</sup> מביאה על גב קנקנה he brings the load of wine in its original vessel (not bottle-wise); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קַנְקַנִּים, קַנְקַנִּין</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 32 היוצר … בודק ק' מרועעים וכ' the potter does not try (knock at) the defective vessels …, but he tries the sound (so God tries not the bad but the good men). Keth. XIII, 4 והודה בק' but admits that he owes the (empty) vessels, v. כַּד II. Ib. 108
<sup>b</sup> יש בלשון הזה לשון ק' the expression ‘vessels of oil’ includes vessels, i.e. one who claims vessels of oil claims not only a certain quantity of oil, but also the vessels. Koh. R. to VII, 28 צפה הקב"ה בכל הק' ולא מצא וכ' the Lord looked at all vessels (fit to receive the Law), and found none better pitched than that of Moses &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. קֶנֶת, a. מָנָא) 
<italic>coulter</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. VI, 4 (80
<sup>a</sup>).—[Erub. 101
<sup>a</sup> ק' הנגרר a plough used as a bar, Rashi; v. next w.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>d</sup> קפוח, v. next. w.—Hor. 11

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>קִיפֵּחֵ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Gen. R. s. 23 (ref. to same.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 23 (ref. to וזה, Gen. XI, 6) ק' על ראשו וכ' he put his hand upon Nimrod’s head, saying, this man &c.; ib. s. 26.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bend, force, outrage, overwhelm</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 118
<sup>a</sup> הקב"ה איֹנו מְקַפֵּחַ שכר וכ' the Lord does not outrage (by withholding) the reward of any creature, i.e. even the wicked are rewarded for what good they may do; Naz. 23
<sup>b</sup> אין … מקפח אפי' שכר וכ' God does not withhold the reward even for a decorous word. Y. Dem. I, 22
<sup>a</sup> איפשר … והוא מְקַפְּחוֹ במים(= מק' שכרו) is it possible? he honored his Creator with water, and he should outrage him with water (allow his daughter to be drowned)?; Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> bot. מקפתו (corr. acc.). Kidd. 52
<sup>b</sup> לקַפְּחֵנִי בהלכות וכ' they come to overwhelm me with citations of traditions (of which they will prove me to be ignorant); Naz. 49
<sup>b</sup>. Num. R. s. 9 (31) קִיפְּחָה נזירות בראשה she forced the nazarite obligations upon her head (the vow was of her own doing); a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְקוּפָּח; f. מְקוּפַּחַת 
<italic>forced, perverted, distorted</italic>. Y. Sot. III, 18
<sup>d</sup> bot. נמצאת מידת הדין מק' justice would appear perverted; Num. R. l. c. Ohol. XVI, 1 אקפח … שזו הלכה מק' may I bury my children (v. infra), if this is not a distorted (misrepresented) 
<italic>hălakhah</italic>; Tosef. ib. XV, 12.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to overpower, take from one by force</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. VIII, 26
<sup>b</sup> bot. יושב … ומקפח הבריות וכ' he will sit at cross-roads and rob the people and kill &c.; (Bab. ib. 72
<sup>a</sup> ומלסטם); Lev. R. s. 30 ומק' לעוברים ושבים. Yoma 83
<sup>b</sup> קִפַּחְתָּ את הרועה thou hast forced the shepherd (to give thee his bread); אני קִפַּחְתִּי … ואתה קפחת וכ' I laid the shepherd under contribution, but thou didst so to the whole town (when they all came to his rescue with refreshments). Pesik. R. s. 3 ראה כמה קי' לוט וכ' see to what extent Lot deprived Abraham of the divine communication!; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cover, bury, survive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ohol. l. c.; Y. Sabb. XVI, 15
<sup>c</sup> bot. אֲקַפֵּחַ את בניי וכ' may I bury my children if &c. (an oath frequently used by R. Ṭarfon). B. Mets. 85
<sup>a</sup> אותו צדיק שהיה מקפח את בניו that righteous man (Ṭarfon) who used to swear by the life of his children. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> אין לך כל נביא … שלא ק' וכ' there was not a single prophet that did not survive four kings &c.; a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>a</italic>) 
<italic>to ruin</italic>. Sabb. 147
<sup>b</sup> חמרא … קִיפְּתוּ וכ' the wine of P’rugitha and the baths of D. (luxurious life) ruined ten tribes of Israel. Kidd. IV, 14 (82
<sup>a</sup>); Tosef. ib. V, 15 קיפחתי את פרנסתי I have ruined my livelihood (forfeited the privilege of support without toil like dumb animals); Y. ib. IV, end, 66
<sup>d</sup> (not קופחתי).—
<italic>b</italic>) 
<italic>to cover up, retain</italic>. Ker. 5
<sup>a</sup> bot. קלט את הריח וקִיפְּחוֹ the oil resorbed the scent and retained it; Hor. 11
<sup>b</sup> קולט … וקפחו (ed. Ven. וקופיחו; corr. acc.); Yalk. Ex. 387 (not וקיפחן).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition> (denom. of קִפֵּחַ) 
<italic>to make high and arched shoulders, to cause</italic> or 
<italic>pretend to be humpbacked</italic>.</definition>

Zech. 583.</notes></sense>
<sense>

B’shall. 17; Mekh. ib., Shirah, s. 6 קפא עליהם וכ' the sea around them was congealed as far as &c.; Yalk. Ex. 248 נִקְפָּה; a. e.—[Tosef. Maasr. I, 7, v. infra.]</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>a</sup>; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11
<sup>b</sup>; [Maim. to Maasr. l. c. seems to read משיִקְפֶּה, expl. 
<italic>to form scum</italic>]. Tosef. l. c. שולה וקופה ed. Zuck. (Var. שילה וקיפה), v. שָׁלָה. Maasr. IV, 1 המְקַפֵּא לתבשיל he that skims for the purpose of taking wine for a dish; Tosef. ib. I, 9 המְקַפֶּה בעריבה he that skims and takes wine out in a trough; a. fr.—In gen. 
<italic>to take from the top</italic>. Ter. IV, 11 סאה … וְקִפְּאָהּ if one S’ah of T’rumah fell on top of a pile, and he took it off. Ib. יְקַפְּאֶנָּה Mish. ed. (Bab. ed. יַקְפִּיאֶנָּה 
<italic>Hif.</italic>; Y. ed. Krot. ייקפינה, read: יְקַפֶּינָּה; Ms. M. יקיפנה, corr. acc.) let him take it off. Y. ib. 43
<sup>a</sup> bot. קפה וחזר וק' if he took from the top once and again; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִקְפִּיא, הִקְפָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same, v. supra.—2) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to cause to float</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> להַקְפּוֹת to keep the wick floating.—3) 
<italic>to curdle, congeal; to cause coagulation; to become thick</italic>. Ḥull. 120
<sup>a</sup>; Men. 21
<sup>a</sup> ה' את הדם if he made the blood thick (through boiling); ib. הִקְפָּהוּ באור Mss. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) if he made it thick by means of artificial heat; הקפהו בחמה by exposure to the sun. Lev. R. s. 14 (ref. to Job X, 10) הִקְפִיאֲתָנִי אינו אומר וכ' it does not read, thou hast curdled me, but thou wilt &c.; Gen. R. s. 14 הִקְפֵּאתַנִי (some ed. הִקְפֵּתַנִי). Num. R. s. 9 (ref. to Ex. XV, 8) ה' שלישו של ים he made one-third of the sea thick (v. supra); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִקְפָּא, נִקְפָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<plural-form>pl. קְפוּלִים</plural-form>. Ohol. XI, 3 ק' זו ע"ג זו folded up (packed) one above the other.</notes></sense></senses>

<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to contract, shrink; to close</italic>.</definition>

<italic>to close the mouth, to indicate </italic>
<pgbrk id="pg1403" />
<italic>one’s will by mimic motions</italic>. Gitt. V, 7 קוֹפֵץ ונִקְפָּץ a deaf and dumb person may transact business by motions with closed lips and by being spoken to in the same way.—Part. pass. קָפוּץ; f. קְפוּצָה &c. Koh. R. to V, 14 כשאדם … ידין הן קְפוּצוֹת וכ' when man enters the world, his hands are clenched, as if saying, the whole world is mine &c., opp. פשוטות straight, open.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to leap (with joined feet), jump; to be excited</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. l. c. אותה קפיצה שקָפַצְתָּ על אבותי בים כן תִּקְפּוֹץ עלי היום ותפלטני ed. Bub. (ed. אותה הקפצה שהִקְפַּצְתָּ על אבותינו כן וכ') with the same leap with which thou didst leap like a hart in aid of my ancestors at the sea, leap now to my aid and save me; Yalk. Ps. l. c. Midr. Till. l. c. 1 קוֹפֵץ כאיל ed. Bub., v. 
<italic>Pi.</italic> Ohol. VIII, 5 הקופץ ממקום וכ' he that jumps from one place to another, contrad. to הדולג (v. קִיפּוּץ). Succ. 49
<sup>b</sup> שמא תאמר כל הבא לִקְפּוֹץ קוֹפֵץ lest you say, whosoever comes to jump may jump (whosoever wishes to do good succeeds in doing real good), we read &c. (Ps. XXXVI, 8). Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> זקנה קופצת עליו old age will spring upon him (will overtake him prematurely). Taan. 5
<sup>b</sup> זקנה קפצה עליו he grew old before his time. Ib. מיד קפצה וכ' Ms. M. (ed. אמר הקב"ה אקפוץ, read אַקְפִּיץ). Sifra Sh’mini, Milluim קפצה פורענות על וכ' punishment overtook Nadab &c. Y. Keth. X, beg. 33
<sup>d</sup> קפצה עליהן ירושת תורה the legal succession according to Biblical law was sprung upon them (they have the precedence); ib. IV, 28
<sup>d</sup> bot. קָפְסָה. Y. Gitt. IV, 46
<sup>d</sup> top כדי … קוֹפְצִין וכ' in order that all may be anxious to marry her. Y. Snh. X, 28
